benefit: White clover undersown into brassicas after establishment fixes 30 to 80 lb of nitrogen per acre while masking the dark soil that attracts adult cabbage root fly. Mow to 4 inches mid-season to keep clover from crowding the crop.

members.title: Frost-seed white clover into established brassica
members.body: Three weeks after brassica transplant, drill or broadcast white clover at 6 to 8 lb per acre between rows. Avoid pre-emergent herbicide carryover.
